description: Staz is the vampire boss of a section of the demon world, but he has little interest in human blood. He's more infatuated with Japanese culture. When he learns that Yanagi Fuyumi, a Japanese teenage girl, accidentally wanders into the demon city, he jumps to the occasion. However, while Staz deals with an intruder on his turf, the oblivious Fuyumi is killed by a monster and becomes a wandering ghost. The disappointed Staz vows to her that he will find a way to bring Fuyumi back to life.

node.description: The human high-school-aged girl who becomes lost in the Demon World through unknown methods and for unknown reasons. She becomes a ghost after being eaten by a carnivorous plant. The triangle headband she dawns is a symbol of this. Yanagi is from Japan, and because of this, [Staz](https://anilist.co/character/36362/Blood-Charlie-Staz) is even more interested in her, often asking about anime and manga from the human world. She wishes to be resurrected as a human, and to help Staz achieve that goal.

name.native: ブラッド・チャーリー・スタズ

node.description:
The vampire, Staz C. Blood, is one of the most powerful district bosses in the demon world, fending off everyone who dares challenge him. But secretly, Staz is also quite obsessed with human culture, especially video games, manga, and everything that comes from Japan.

When Staz makes a decision that he wants something, he's known for always accomplishing his goal and getting or doing whatever it is that he set out for. So, when the young Japanese girl, [Fuyumi](https://anilist.co/character/36361/Yanagi-Fuyumi), wanders into the demon world by accident and dies, Staz declares that he'll help bring her back to life and is determined to do just that. And in helping her he also gets the chance to travel to the human world, somewhere he's always dreamed of going.

Staz is sometimes viewed by others as having a lazy look about him, though they never do well to underestimate him as he's also very powerful. He has rapid healing abilities, as well as the ability to paralyze weaker demons with his stare, he's able to control humans and alter memories with his saliva, can suck out other demon's magic with his teeth, and can crush someone's heart from afar. He sometimes says things like "I might be a vampire, but first and foremost i'm me" and once lost his temper and nearly killed his friend Wolf while they were fighting when he questioned Staz's reasons for helping Fuyumi, and then scoffed at his statement of being himself before being a vampire. He's very stubborn, and is also notorius for his lack of common sense and his sometimes impetuous behavior.

~!Staz is from a "high breed" of vampires that live in the Demon World Acropolis, though he's reluctant to associate himself with them (one of the reasons for his saying "I might be a vampire, but first and foremost i'm me"). He became an East Territory boss after he ran away from his home in the Demon World Acropolis after his older brother, [Braz](https://anilist.co/character/36778/Blood-Braz-D), sealed most of his magic away by shooting him in the heart with a binding spell bullet when he was young.!~

__Height:__ 163 cm

A sorceress of the highest quality, she meets up with [Yanagi](https://anilist.co/character/36361/Yanagi-Fuyumi) and [Staz](https://anilist.co/character/36362/Blood-Charlie-Staz) after they use her gateway connecting Hell and Earth after it was stolen from her. She has expressed interest both in unsealing Staz's powers and it is hinted that she has a crush on him. A naturally outgoing and goofy person, she is rarely seen without her giant backpack.

name.native: ブリドカット・セーラ・恵美

node.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm
__Abilities:__ Werewolf, Strength
__Weapons:__ Magic, Iron rod

An experienced and talented street fighter, Wolf is a long time friend and rival of [Staz](https://anilist.co/character/36362/Blood-Charlie-Staz). 

Wolf was abandoned by his parents for not being a pure werewolf. When Wolf gets over-hyped, he grows claws and he grows a snout. Wolf is a mildly short-tempered young man, but with great ambition. He is very powerful and strong-willed, and thinks very highly of his strength. However, he knows he is not stronger than Staz, but still continues to challenge him to battles as he becomes stronger. The supposed reason to his attempt to conquer all the territory in the Lower Demon World is so that he will prove his strength, and be finally accepted by the same family who abandoned him, including his father, the King of the Demon World Acropolis.

Additionally, Wolf demonstrates a very caring nature, despite his "rough" outer personality, as displayed by his actions towards [Fuyumi](https://anilist.co/character/36361/Yanagi-Fuyumi) and his friends in danger. He seems to have a small crush on Fuyumi, despite him saying she's not his type.

name.native: ブラッド・D・ブラッズ

node.description: Braz Daniel Blood (ブラッド・D・ブラッズ) is the oldest sibling of the Blood Family. He lives in the Blood Estate in the Demon World Acropolis, and is also a noble, pure-blood vampire like Staz.
Staz's head enforcer in Eastern hell.
A rookie Eastern Hell enforcer, Yoshida has the ability to replicate anyone's appearance. Currently, he is filling in as Staz's double in Eastern Hell.
Owner of the Cafe "The Third Eye'. She never speaks , but does communicate with Beans.
A creature of high magical properties. It can speak and combine its power with Satie.
Staz's younger sister. Liz is in charge of keeping order in hell and determines the guilt or innocence of an individual and, subsequently, delivers a deserving punishment.

name.native: パップラドン・アキム

node.description: An artificial demon (Dubbed "Artificial Demon Number 9") delivered to Franken Stein, who battles Staz. He was originally a demon named Pantomime, who was performing a top-secret mission for Father Wolf before he suddenly became out of contact. He has something to do with Fuyumi's appearance in the Demon World.   ~!It is revealed that that Braz captured him and delivered him to Stein as a test subject to perform his experiments on.!~
Bell's and Fuyumi's brother.   ~!He is ordered by his mother (Neyn) to kidnap Fuyumi and bring her to their family estate.!~

Beros works below Goyle, as an Officer of the Demon World Acropolis Police, who are under the command of King Wolf. As a member of the police force, she is in charge of maintaining peace and order in the Demon World. Her specialty goes hand in hand with her job, as it acts as an effective restraint on any magical being.

name.native: フランケン・シュタイン

node.description: The mad scientist of the demon world. He helps Wolf keep Fuyumi from disappearing.

[Bell](https://anilist.co/character/36772/Hydra-Bell) and [Nell](https://anilist.co/character/52329/Hydra-Nell)'s mother. Lives at Hydra, part of the dimensional highway, in the demon world.

~!Long ago, she met her doppelgänger in the human world (Fuyumi's mother) and fused with her, and is therefore Bell and [Fuyumi](https://anilist.co/character/36361/Yanagi-Fuyumi)'s mother.!~

Goyle (ゴイル部長) is the Police Chief of his division under King Wolf. He is the boss of Beros. As a member of the Acropolis police, he is in charge of maintaining peace and order. His anger, which can get somewhat out of hand, manifests into a demon creature from inside him, called "Angry" or "Spear-head of Fury", which is one of his dispensations. He is somewhat friendly with Braz.

The father of Nell and Bell. He is the Hydra, and can move about creating space, which is where both Nell and Bell gained their powers from. In addition, he switches between a dragon form and a more human-like form.   ~!The only enemy he is afraid of is Yanagi, Fuyumi's father. Because of this, he allows Staz to take Fuyumi back with him, in order to not take away another loved one from Yanagi. He has something to do with Fuyumi ending up in the demon world, after being ordered to give his transportation magic to Phantomime.!~

The King of the demon world and the main antagonist of the series.

~!He may have killed the Blood siblings' father.!~

Fuyumi's father.   ~!The doppleganger of the Hydra's family butler. After being told that his wife had merged with her doppleganger Neyn, he decides that he will raise Fuyumi by himself, in order to give her a normal human life.!~
The demon who runs the demon's world's famously popular brand "Oniqlo" human world branch. The store also contains the Great Devil Underwear.
